Title: Public Preview: Live Resize for Azure Premium SSD v2 and Ultra Disks

Body.Content:
We’re excited to announce the Public Preview of Live Resize for Premium SSD v2 and Ultra Disks. Dynamically increase the storage capacity of your disks without causing any disruption to your applications. To reduce costs, you can begin by creating smaller disks and gradually increase their storage capacity without experiencing any downtime.

For details on how to begin using Live Resize, click here.
